goal: Report database read errors and corruption during transaction index lookups instead of masking them
Callers learn of internal database failures rather than falsely being told a transaction does not exist
agreement: Asked if iterator checks should be centralized, which author answered with benchmarks (andrewtoth)
Suggested providing a reproducer test script for reviewers (maflcko)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because it prevents silent error masking during transaction index lookups
Database read failures and corruption are raised as errors instead of returning false missing results
